Requirement: [E]nable users to request and receive coverage requirements.

Support the capability to initiate and exchange information as a “CRD Client” to enable the identification of coverage requirements according to at least one of the versions of the implementation specification adopted in § [170.215(j)(1)](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-45/section-170.215#p-170.215(j)(1)).
Support registration capabilities applicable to “CRD Clients”.
Support the capabilities in [paragraph (j)(20)](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-45/section-170.315#p-170.315(j)(20)) of this section to enable workflow triggers to call decision support services
Support all requirements and required capabilities applicable to a “CRD Client.”

Supported API server capabilities of “CRD Clients” from an implementation specification adopted in [170.215(j)(1)](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-45/section-170.215#p-170.215(j)(1)) must include complete accompanying technical documentation.

Support the requirements applicable to a “CDS Client” according to at least one of the implementation specifications in [§ 170.215(f)](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-45/section-170.215#p-170.215(f))
Support registration capabilities applicable to “CDS Clients”.
Support ... client authentication using JSON web tokens (JWT).
Support ... data access authorization of a “CDS Service” using access tokens.
Support the execution of decision support workflow triggers.
Send a decision support request to a “CDS Service”
Support access to HL7 FHIR Resources via a RESTful API to support decision support intervention workflows according to the “FHIR Resource Access” section.
Support the receipt of a decision support response, including support for the display of the contents of a decision support response to an end-user.
